# TensorRT-Model-Connect

> Build TensorRT bundles from Python-first checkpoints and run them through a native C++ task API.

Documentation: https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/
Repository: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-Model-Connect

## Start here

- [Overview](https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/)
- [Quick Start](https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/getting-started/quick-start)
- [Supported Models](https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/models-recipes/overview)
- [Architecture](https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/architecture/ai-native-horizontal-scaling)
- [Python Build API](https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/api/python-builder)
- [C++ Task API](https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/api/cpp-api)
- [Add a Model Family](https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/extend/add-model-family)
- [Source Layout](https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-Model-Connect/reference/source-layout)

## Sources of truth

- Complete family ownership: families/<family>/
- Python build entry: families/<family>/model.py
- Native runtime target: families/<family>/runtime/CMakeLists.txt
- Direct E2E contracts: families/<family>/tests/manifests/*.json
- Public task interfaces: core/runtime/include/trtmc/task.h
- Build and runtime loader contracts: core/builder/tensorrt_model_connect/ and core/runtime/include/trtmc/runtime/
- CLI: trtmc help
